name: Susukawa Mizore
source: A guest character from "[url=/v28562]Tomodachi Kara Koibito e[/url]." She works as a writer for the video game company "Nozarashi Soft," under the pen name "Mizorekawa Susu." On [url=/c151235]Kodama[/url]'s order, she acts as a scenario advisor for the game being created by [url=/c150926]Yukihisa[/url] and his team. She is currently engaged.
